requirement: stand.mjs down removes each stand container with its anonymous volumes, so a slot pass no longer leaves the database's MariaDB data (~180 MB) on the Docker disk

oracle.ref: PR #1100 (fix); fix evidence: 10/10/2026: twelve dangling MariaDB volumes (a 'site' database each, 173–190 MB), created seconds after each stand this session raised, were left after stand.mjs down; removed by hand (Docker disk 8.4 GB → 9.3 GB free).
oracle.invariant: S1 exits 0; 'down' prints {"down":true}; the recorded calls include 'rm -f -v reg-down-probe-web', 'rm -f -v reg-down-probe-db' and 'network rm reg-down-probe'.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
